messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff: env=staging, release_tag=v2.4.1, commit=abc1234, started by @maya. Initiating CI gate checks.

ci-gate-bot: CI gate: FAIL — 2 checks failed: unit-tests (service-api) and lint (web). Details: https://ci.redwood/1456 (logs).

lina: saw the lint earlier, but unit-tests failing on my machine too. reprod with local DB mock.

rob: if unit tests are failing I'd pause all canaries. @maya do we want to continue partial rollout or abort?

maya: holding. do not promote. arjun can you look at the failing test? we'll decide rollback vs fix-on-master.

arjun: looking now. quick log snippet: 
```
FAIL: test_migration_idempotency (tests.test_migrations)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/service-api/tests/test_migrations.py", line 45, in test_migration_idempotency
    self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)
AssertionError: 500 != 200
```

ci-gate-bot: Note: commit abc1229 (previous) had passing results; this failure introduced in abc1234. Full job link: https://ci.redwood/1456/build/3

maya: decision: abort deploy to staging for now. we'll pin staging back to v2.4.0 to unblock dependent work. I'll create a quick ticket and annotate the release notes.

rob: suggested rollback command: `rdeploy rollback --env staging --to-tag v2.4.0` — I'll run and monitor.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by maya: rolling staging to v2.4.0 (commit def567). Status: in-progress.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete — staging now at v2.4.0 (commit def567). CI gate prevented risky promotion.

lina: running QA smoke against staging now... smoke checks green :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and include failing tests + action items (fix test flakiness, add DB fixture to CI). Plan is to cut v2.4.1-rc1 after tests are fixed.

arjun: noted, starting a debug branch and will SR a small fix + test update.

rob: leaving a brief note in the release channel and adding an incident tag so we can track. :thumbsup:
